# UiCard

A compact surface with header, body, footer and actions slots.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | display |
| Import | `import { UiCard } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiCard from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiCard'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/display/UiCard.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/display/UiCard.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `UiSurfaceVariant` |  | Visual variant. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |
| `padding` | `UiPadding` |  |  |
| `title` | `string` |  | Heading text. Use the `header` slot for richer content. |
| `description` | `string` |  | Supporting text under the title. |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | `3` | Heading level of `title`. Pick the level that fits the page outline. |
| `as` | `string` | `'div'` | Root element, e.g. `section` or `article` for a landmark-worthy card. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` |  | Card body. |
| `header` |  | Replaces the `title`/`description` heading. |
| `actions` |  | Controls aligned to the end of the header row. |
| `footer` |  | Footer row, typically buttons. |

## Attributes

The root element (`as`, default `<div>`).

## Accessibility

- `title` renders a real heading (`headingLevel`).
- With `as="section"`/`"article"` the root is labelled by the title.
- The card is an inline-size container: narrow cards stack their footer buttons.

## Styling

- `.vui-card`, `.vui-card__header`, `.vui-card__title`, `.vui-card__description`, `.vui-card__actions`, `.vui-card__body`, `.vui-card__footer`
- `data-variant`, `data-padding`
- `--vui-card-min`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/DisplayDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/DisplayDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
  <UiCard
    v-for="variant in ['outline', 'soft', 'elevated', 'plain'] as const"
    :key="variant"
    :variant="variant"
    :title="t('demo.card.title')"
    :heading-level="4"
  >
    <p>{{ t('demo.card.body') }}</p>
    <template #actions><UiBadge color="success" dot>{{ t('demo.badge.active') }}</UiBadge></template>
    <template #footer>
      <UiButton variant="ghost" color="neutral" size="sm">{{ t('demo.cancel') }}</UiButton>
      <UiButton size="sm">{{ t('demo.save') }}</UiButton>
    </template>
  </UiCard>
</div>
```
